description: Flat metadata schema for individual in vivo electrophysiology recording records from mouse cortex using multielectrode arrays, including LFP, spike trains, stimulus context, and behavioral annotations.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the recording record, session, or file within the dataset.

subject_id.descr: Unique identifier for the mouse subject.

species.descr: Species of the subject; expected value: Mus musculus.

strain.descr: Mouse strain or line used in the experiment, e.g., C57BL/6J, transgenic line name.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the subject, e.g., male, female, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the mouse at the time of recording, in days.

body_weight_g.descr: Body weight of the subject at the time of recording, in grams.

recording_date.descr: Date of the recording in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

experimenter_id.descr: Identifier or name of the person who performed the recording.

institution.descr: Institution or laboratory where the recording was performed.

animal_housing_condition.descr: Brief description of housing conditions relevant to the experiment, e.g., standard, enriched, reversed light cycle.

ethical_approval_id.descr: Animal ethics or IACUC approval identifier for the experiment.

recording_type.descr: Type of recording, e.g., acute, chronic, anesthetized, awake behaving.

anesthesia_used.descr: Whether anesthesia was used during the recording.

anesthesia_agent.descr: Name of anesthetic agent(s) used, if applicable.

behavioral_state.descr: Behavioral state during recording, e.g., awake, running, resting, engaged task.

behavioral_task_name.descr: Name of the behavioral task, e.g., decision-making task, go/no-go, two-alternative choice.

behavioral_task_description.descr: Free-text description of the behavioral paradigm and task structure.

trial_id.descr: Identifier for the trial or behavioral episode associated with the recording segment, if applicable.

trial_type.descr: Categorical label for the trial type, e.g., correct, incorrect, rewarded, unrewarded, control.

stimulus_presented.descr: Whether a stimulus was presented during the recorded segment.

stimulus_type.descr: Type of stimulus used, e.g., auditory, visual, tactile, olfactory, none.

stimulus_parameters.descr: Stimulus parameters associated with the record, such as intensity, frequency, duration, timing, or spatial position; use a structured string or serialized object if multiple values are needed.

behavioral_annotations.descr: Behavioral event annotations for the record, such as lick, lever press, choice, reward, movement onset; use a structured string or serialized object if multiple events are present.

recording_start_time.descr: Start time of the recording segment relative to experiment start, in seconds.

recording_duration_s.descr: Duration of the recording segment, in seconds.

brain_region.descr: Primary brain region recorded, e.g., motor cortex, prefrontal cortex, somatosensory cortex.

cortical_layer.descr: Cortical layer targeted or recorded from, if known, e.g., L2/3, L4, L5, L6.

hemisphere.descr: Hemisphere of the recorded area, e.g., left, right, bilateral.

atlas_coordinates_mm.descr: Stereotaxic coordinates of the recording site relative to a brain atlas, in millimeters; use a structured object if multiple axes are recorded.

electrode_array_type.descr: Type or model of the multielectrode array used, e.g., silicon probe, tetrode array, Utah array.

electrode_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer of the electrode array or probe.

electrode_channel_count.descr: Total number of electrode channels recorded.

electrode_spacing_um.descr: Spacing between electrodes or recording sites, in micrometers.

electrode_impedance_ohm.descr: Typical or nominal electrode impedance, in ohms.

electrode_placement_method.descr: Method used to place the electrode array, e.g., stereotaxic insertion, surface placement.

reference_method.descr: Electrical reference scheme used for the recordings, e.g., common average, ground, reference electrode location.

ground_location.descr: Location of the ground electrode, if applicable.

lfp_sampling_rate_hz.descr: Sampling rate for local field potential data, in Hz, if different from the main acquisition rate.

spike_sampling_rate_hz.descr: Sampling rate or timestamp resolution used for spike detection or sorting, in Hz, if applicable.

filter_low_cutoff_hz.descr: Low-frequency cutoff used during acquisition or preprocessing, in Hz.

filter_high_cutoff_hz.descr: High-frequency cutoff used during acquisition or preprocessing, in Hz.

notch_filter_hz.descr: Notch filter frequency applied to remove line noise, in Hz, e.g., 50 or 60.

amplifier_gain.descr: Amplifier gain used during acquisition, as a unitless multiplier.

signal_types_included.descr: Types of signals included in the record, e.g., LFP, spike trains, raw broadband, multiunit activity.

lfp_present.descr: Whether local field potential data are included in the record.

spike_trains_present.descr: Whether spike train data are included in the record.

spike_sorting_method.descr: Method or software used for spike sorting, if performed.

unit_count.descr: Number of isolated single units identified in the record, if applicable.

multiunit_count.descr: Number of multiunit activity clusters or channels, if applicable.

artifact_rejection_applied.descr: Whether artifact rejection or cleaning was applied to the signals.

artifact_rejection_method.descr: Method used for artifact rejection, if applicable.

preprocessing_steps.descr: Ordered description of preprocessing steps applied, e.g., filtering, re-referencing, downsampling, normalization.

data_format.descr: File or storage format of the record, e.g., NWB, HDF5, MATLAB, CSV.

file_name.descr: Name of the data file associated with the record.

file_path.descr: Relative or absolute path to the data file.

checksum.descr: Checksum or hash for integrity verification of the file, e.g., SHA256 string.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the specific recording record.
